FROM mswebench/google_m_gson@sha256:135ea364c947f1959102c1efe6f085e879f756cc8eecb3ded672b3c3c0f93d7e

WORKDIR /home/gson
RUN git ls-files -z > /tmp/codenib-selected-files \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && rm -f /home/fix.patch /home/test.patch /home/fix-run.sh \
        /home/test-run.sh /home/prepare.sh /home/check_git_changes.sh \
    && git init -q \
    && git config user.name Benchmark \
    && git config user.email benchmark@example.invalid \
    && git add --force --pathspec-from-file=/tmp/codenib-selected-files --pathspec-file-nul \
    && git commit -qm 'chore(benchmark): initialize selected source snapshot' \
    && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = abba7deda8852191b18a879e838fbbea4a8b19ff \
    && test "$(git rev-list --all --count)" = 1 \
    && test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" \
    && python3 --version \
    && rm /tmp/codenib-selected-files
